notes: Photonics2d has no volume budget (volume_condition is null), so the feasibility and condition families report themselves unavailable rather than producing a number. Latent instrument selected by the four gates in engiopt.lvae.select_instrument over 14 candidate arms: 0d2dd396 (performance constraint ON, rec threshold 0.15) compresses to 21 active dimensions with an across-seed CV of 0.09, reaches val NMSE 0.388 (1.22x the best candidate's), and maximises partial Spearman against residual performance at +0.366. Its recon-only companion 28a16723 was trained at the same 0.15 reconstruction threshold with the constraint off, which is what makes lv_dual_gap isolate the constraint rather than a difference in reconstruction budget. The gap between the two families is the measurement: every performance-constrained arm scores rho_residual 0.32-0.37, every reconstruction-only arm scores 0.005-0.17, and two of them score negative.
